items.author: BitcoinNews
items.context: @BitcoinNews (3.254.244 seguidores): "Despite a 51% drawdown from ATH, Glassnode data shows $BTC is still trading above its realized price, the average cost basis of every coin on the network. A dip below MVRV would put the average #Bitcoin holder at a loss for the first time since 2023." Post de ~6 min con 8 likes, 2 respuestas y 6635 vistas, creciendo rápido.
items.suggested_text:
Realized price is one of the cleanest floors on-chain data offers, because it's the market's own cost basis rather than a line someone drew on a chart. Historically, the stretches with MVRV below 1 have lined up with some of the best long-term entries, and also with the most uncomfortable months to hold.

On its own it's still one lens. I track it inside a composite Market Temperature index: MVRV, price vs the 200-week average, drawdown from the high and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum, 25% each. It went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122727211610542288

A 51% drawdown with the average holder still in profit says a lot about how high that cost basis climbed this cycle.
